title: Peruvian Picarones with Yellowed Boudin Filling
description: A traditional Peruvian dessert featuring sweet potato donuts (picarones) filled with a rich and savory boudin mixture.
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a bowl. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the dough mix, egg, and salt to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Let the dough rest for 1 hour.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the dough balls until golden brown.
In a separate pan, heat the crumbled yellowed boudin over medium heat.
Add the noir sugar to the boudin and mix until combined.
Fill the fried picarones with the boudin mixture.
